fato_historico: 2013: The first Minotaur V rocket is launched from the Mid-Atlantic Regional Spaceport on Wallops Island, carrying NASA's LADEE spacecraft.
energia_do_dia: Today carries the bold spark of discovery, much like a rocket soaring toward the moon to unravel celestial mysteries. For you, Leo, it is a good time to launch your own ambitious plans into the universe. Consider this energy a cosmic invitation to explore uncharted territories within your heart and shine your radiant light upon every new path you choose.
frase_do_dia: Aim high, for your inner light is capable of touching the distant moon.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of big dreams into tangible reality.
conselho: Trust your inner guidance and launch your boldest ideas with confidence and joy.
